name: proto-well-known-copy-below-a-directory-outside-the-import-paths
description: A copy of a well-known schema kept below a directory outside proto.import_paths is no schema file the build reads: every import of its upstream path reads the file of protoc's own include directory, so the copy publishes nothing and a schema-unparsed note names it, and the importer's field is decided by its bindings. Since a schema file not read cleanly, a shadowed one included, may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
